visuals.advice: Add before/after pictures to the description: simulator screenshots for how it looks, a GIF for how it moves or responds (a card swipe, an animation, a sheet or modal opening and closing, scrolling, a multi-step flow). Screenshot: `xcrun simctl io booted screenshot after.png`, or without a Mac the `ios-screenshots` artifact of CI's Screenshots and GIFs job (Setup, the sort sheet, Sift, the decisions list, Settings and Done, light and dark); never a web export, which draws every SF Symbol as an empty box. GIF: add or edit the scenario in e2e/gifs/ for the motion this PR changes (a Maestro flow; swipe-and-undo.yaml says how one is built), push, then `node scripts/pr-gifs.mjs <PR number>` records main and this branch, makes the GIFs, commits them to the screenshots branch and prints the Before | After table to paste (`--side-by-side` adds a labelled pair, `--no-before` is for a screen main doesn't have); on a Mac by hand, `xcrun simctl io booted recordVideo --codec=h264 swipe.mov`. To host pictures yourself, drag them into the description, or commit them to a folder named for the topic on the screenshots branch (one branch for every PR's pictures, never a new one per topic) and link them by that commit's SHA, raw.githubusercontent.com/jbhirsh/sift/<sha>/<topic>/..., so a later push can't change what this PR shows. Or tick "No visible UI change" in the template. Editing the description re-runs this check.
